thread:
pagerbot: P0 Alert — possible auth header fragments observed in outbound logforwarder to external-logbroker. Spike at 22:19 UTC. Samples flagged: 7.

maria (oncall): I'm oncall, joining bridge. starting triage.

sam (eng): where did this originate? telemetry-pipeline or proxy?

priya (security): initial traces show entries from auth-proxy svc (auth-proxy-v2) that passed through telemetry-forwarder. could be masked header fragments in debug logs.

maria (oncall): can we pause the forwarder? @teras please block egress to external-logbroker immediately.

teras (infra): ack. bumping firewall rule and pausing log-forwarder task set. doing role revoke for forwarder-role now.

devops-bot: action: paused service telemetry-log-forwarder (taskset id: tlf-8a7). revoke-role executed on forwarder-role.

sam (eng): quick grep on archived bucket to find tokens. running: 
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-telemetry-archive/2026/03/18/logs.gz - | zgrep -i 'authorization\|auth:' -m 200
```

priya (security): run limited grep, do not copy outputs to external places. share counts only.

sam (eng): count = 18 matches in the last 12 hours, 3 of them look like truncated "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" snippets.

maria (oncall): customer impact? any outgoing API calls using leaked fragments?

nate (cust-success): prepping customer-impact slate. so far no inbound abuse reports. will ready comms if we need to notify.

priya (security): escalate to rotate affected service tokens and ephemeral keys: telemetry-forwarder-role keys + auth-proxy signing key. Recommend immediate key rotation and short-term mitigation: disable debug loglevel on auth-proxy, enforce header scrub.

lgl (legal): please preserve logs and actions for chain-of-custody. hold off on external comms until we confirm scope, but prepare for notification if tokens used.

maria (oncall): plan: 1) block forwarder (done) 2) rotate forwarder-role keys (teras + sam) 3) scrub logs and run full search (observability-bot) 4) disable debug logging in auth-proxy and deploy safe patch 5) assess customer impact and prepare comms.

teras (infra): rotating keys now. kube secret rotated for telemetry-forwarder svc-account -> new IAM keys issued and old keys revoked.

sam (eng): deploying auth-proxy patch to strip Authorization header from any debug context. rolling canary to 10% now.

observability-bot: search complete: 42 total header-fragment matches across last 7 days, 6 with Bearer-like pattern. Correlated to 3 internal service accounts.

priya (security): recommend forced rotate for the 3 service accounts and run replay detection for any unusual token use.

maria (oncall): handing off to security for longer investigation. @priya please take lead. I'll stay on until keys rotate and patch verified.

priya (security): taking lead. creating incident dossier and timeline. tagging legal and cust-success for potential notice. (reaction :rotating_light:)

maria (oncall): thanks team. closing bridge after verification. log-forwarder remains paused. next update in 30m or earlier if new findings.

pagerbot: Incident status changed -> mitigated (initial). severity remains P0 until rotation & replay checks complete.
